steps.message: What would you like help with?

Netcare appointmed can help find an appropriate healthcare professional based on your requirements and, where relevant, your medical-aid network. You can now request the appointment online, in the Netcare app or by calling 0860 555 565.
You’re ready for the next step. I’ll take you to the official Netcare appointmed service rather than asking you to search the website yourself.
Which kind of help do you need?
General Netcare customer service is 0860 638 2273, Monday to Friday, 08:00 to 16:00.
Hospital account queries are handled on 010 205 7335, Monday to Friday, 08:00 to 17:00. You can also SMS your ID number, patient name and hospital to 43235 for a callback.
Netcare 911 provides 24-hour emergency medical services. In an emergency, get emergency medical help immediately.
